caseName: Goodyear Farms v. City of Avondale
caseNameFull: Goodyear Farms v. City of Avondale
judges: Brennan, Consideration, Hearing, Jurisdiction, Merits, Postpone, Question

opinions.text:
Appeal from Sup. Ct. Ariz. Motion of Arizona for leave to intervene granted. Appeal dismissed for want of substantial federal question.

Justice Brennan and Justice White would postpone further consideration of the question of jurisdiction to a hearing of the case on the merits.
